text:
marco.liu: Posting updated compact card mock for autoscale controls. Main problem: when the pool name wraps to two lines the min/max steppers get pushed under and feel disconnected. Also burst chip overlaps on narrow cards. Thoughts?

 tess_reynolds: Saw it. Two options: 1) enforce single-line pool names with ellipsis and tooltip for full name, or 2) allow wrap but pin controls to a bottom row with subtle divider. I prefer 2 for discoverability.

 emily_ng: Agree on pinning controls. If we keep controls anchored, we need to ensure vertical rhythm doesn't grow too tall on lists. Maybe a compact row height and smaller type for pool meta.

 dana_ops: A11y: pinned bottom row must still be in DOM order before action menu so keyboard users encounter controls predictably. Also ensure each stepper button has `aria-label` like "Decrease min GPUs" and "Increase max GPUs".

 tess_reynolds: UX: for burst chip copy, what about showing current delta e.g., "Burst +2" and on hover show full policy name and limits. If no active burst show "Burst off" with muted style.

 marco.liu: Good. CSS note: use grid with two rows: grid-template-rows: 1fr auto; top row holds title/meta, bottom row holds controls. That keeps the bottom row fixed. For narrow widths collapse numbers to condensed inline with +/- icons only.

 emily_ng: We tried condensed steppers in earlier prototypes and some folks missed the explicit numeric input. Suggest adding a small inline number that opens a native numeric input modal on click for fine-tuning. Keeps list density and allows precision.

 tess_reynolds: SLO slider: show bucket label (Fast/Balanced/Cheap) above the handle and ms in an inline tooltip on drag. Also include short helper text beneath: "Choosing Faster increases cost; try Balanced for steady workloads."

 dana_ops: Accessibility checklist: focus-visible outline on the slider handle, aria-valuetext that reads human-friendly text "Balanced  120ms", and ensure contrast between bucket label and background meets 4.5:1. Also add `role=status` live region for changes that affect billing estimates.

 tess_reynolds: Copy tweak: change "Min" to "Min kept warm" and "Max" to "Max autoscale". Short but clearer.

 marco.liu: Decision proposals: 1) Pin control row, 2) Burst chip always right-aligned with priority to keep steppers visible, 3) Compact numeric entry modal for precision, 4) SLO buckets with ms tooltip. Approve or veto?

 emily_ng: Approve with one tweak: when pool name is ellipsized (if we decide for single-line variant in dense lists), include accessible tooltip that triggers on focus and hover.

 dana_ops: Approve. I'll add ARIA spec to the ticket.

 design-bot: Reminder: link updated Figma file in ticket and tag with `ui-autoscale-controls` and `a11y-review`.

 marco.liu: Action items:
- tess_reynolds: update mock with pinned control row + burst chip right-aligned + inline ms tooltip for SLO.
- emily_ng: prototype condensed stepper -> numeric modal interaction.
- dana_ops: draft ARIA guidance and run quick contrast/aXe pass.
- marco.liu: update ticket with final decisions and attach figma.

 tess_reynolds: I'll have mocks by EOD Wednesday. Thanks! :rocket:
